test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate choice.

In more civilized times even the most _______ enemies were treated with dignity.
solution:
The correct answer is "**implacable**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **In the given sentence, it means that even the most unyielding enemies were treated with dignity in more civilized times. **
 
• Among the given options, the most appropriate word to fill the blank is "implacable.&
